estilo: Editorial product photography for a specialty coffee roaster's website. Warm natural window light from the left, soft long shadows, shallow depth of field, shot on a medium format camera. Muted earthy palette: cream, oat, espresso brown, terracotta and sage. Calm, premium, minimal, lots of negative space. No people's faces, no logos of real brands, no watermarks, no extra text.

imagenes.prompt: A pour-over coffee being brewed on a light oak counter: a ceramic cone dripper on a glass carafe, a thin stream of hot water from a gooseneck kettle, steam rising, freshly roasted coffee beans scattered on a linen cloth, a small ceramic cup. Composition leaves the left two thirds darker and calmer for a headline overlay; the brewing scene sits on the right third.

Inside a small coffee roastery: a vintage drum coffee roaster with copper and black enamel details, freshly roasted beans tumbling in the round cooling tray, a wisp of smoke, a wooden scoop resting on the edge. Only hands and forearms of the roaster may appear, no face.

A matte cream ceramic cone coffee dripper with spiral ribs inside, sitting on a small glass carafe, a folded unbleached paper filter beside it, on a cream linen surface. Centered product shot, no brand marks.

A neat stack of unbleached brown cone paper coffee filters, slightly fanned out, tied with a thin cotton string, on a cream linen surface with a few roasted coffee beans. Centered product shot, no brand marks, no text.

A manual coffee grinder with a brushed stainless steel body, a walnut wood knob and a folding crank, standing upright on a cream linen surface, a small pile of ground coffee and whole beans beside it. Centered product shot, no brand marks, no text.

A matte stand-up coffee pouch (250 g) in warm cream paper with a wide terracotta horizontal band across the lower middle. Minimal typographic label printed on the pouch: the brand name "TOSTELA" in an elegant soft serif near the top, and on the terracotta band the origin "ETIOPÍA" in spaced capital letters, with "Yirgacheffe · Lavado" in small text below it. A small round saffron yellow sticker on the top right corner of the pouch. A small scoop of freshly roasted coffee beans spilled in front. Centered product shot on a cream linen surface, slight three-quarter angle, the whole pouch visible with margin around it.
